operative_context: ## 2.5.1 (REVISED) Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the status to 'Maintenance'.
System maintains full lifecycle history with timestamps and user identifiers for all status changes and lifecycle events
Status updates are applied immediately when triggered
exceptions: Rent records in Requested status can be modified; records in Approved, Active, Completed, Rejected, or Cancelled status cannot be modified unless explicitly permitted
Cancellation is allowed for Requested status (any user) and Approved/Active status (authorized users only); cancellation is prevented for Completed or Cancelled records
Manual activation is allowed only for records in Approved status
Manual completion is allowed only for records in Active status
conflicts_or_obsolete: TOOLCHAIN-CONF-RENT-01.md (E8) specifies status transitions to Completed at rental end date; TOOLCHAIN-CONF-RENT-01-v1.2.md (E1, E2) revises this to transition to Maintenance instead, with subsequent transition to Available after maintenance period
gaps_or_uncertainties: Exact behavior depends on a category- or matrix-based rule that is not fully specified in the retrieved evidence.
